description: Eco Mode model substitutions. When user.eco_mode=true and the requested model has a mapping here, the carbon middleware mutates form.Model BEFORE the chat completion handler runs. Billing follows the mutated model (channel.ChargeInstance.GetCharge(form.Model)), so user saves both money and CO2. Per-chat override (long-press toggle) bypasses this for one turn.

mappings.notes: older GPT-4 to small efficient model; estimated coefficient delta, low confidence
modest improvement; gpt-3.5-turbo is already small but 4o-mini is newer + more efficient

calibration_note: expected_savings_pct is the estimated coefficient delta from carbon_factors.json: (from_g - to_g) / from_g * 100. Recompute when factors change. The unit test TestEcoRouting_SavingsMatchFactors enforces this within ±0.5pp. Note: this is internal consistency — it does NOT validate the underlying carbon estimates. See Methodology page for limitations.
